summary: Resolved DS4-R3/R4 by adding Angular Forms to preflight/major consistency checks and completing real TestBed coverage for named controls and disabled radio interaction.

resolutions.description: @angular/forms now participates in policy resolution, lockfile inspection and Angular-major consistency checks; it remains installable at init when absent, but declared incompatible ranges block before the dependency plan can preserve them.

Added formControlName interaction tests for select, checkbox and radio group. The radio handler now receives the option and ignores synthetic or native change attempts for disabled options; the test asserts control and output stay unchanged.
